description: Read version history, recorded decisions, and sync history from a running n8n-workflow-manager. Requires the N8N_MCP_MANAGER_URL environment variable; without it, this MCP talks to n8n directly and no such history exists. Read-only.

workflow_id.description: Manager workflow ID (NOT the n8n instance ID). Omit to list the known workflows.

name: n8n_manager_history
